title: Karta AI handles 2 million conversations a month: What’s driving its voice AI growth?
description: Karta AI, a Bengaluru-based voice AI startup, is targeting complex customer service queries in the financial services sector. Co-founder and CEO Vijaypal Singh says the company’s technology uses a context engine to pull information from multiple systems and resolve customer issues end to end. The startup, which handles around 2 million conversations a month, has raised $3 million to improve automation, drive enterprise adoption and strengthen its leadership team. Karta AI is also exploring expansion into the US and the Middle East, targeting $2 million to $3 million in annual recurring revenue by the end of next year.
